Hedgehog

Description Habitat

A hedgehog is a spiny mammal of the subfamily Erinaceinae. There are seventeen species found across parts of Europe, Asia and Africa, and they were introduced to New Zealand. See Mammal, Europe and Nocturnal animal.

Description

Hedgehogs have short legs and a body covered in spines. [1]
